params.body:
Four changes to the article section that hoet-sanity #12 added.

## Journal becomes Blog

The Studio shows *Blog* (with *Artikels*, *Categorieën*, *Tags* under it) where it showed *Journal*. The *Voorbeeld* action opens `/{lang}/blog/preview/{id}`. The type names (`journalPost`, `journalCategory`, `journalTag`) stay as they are: the site mirrors documents by type, and renaming types would mean migrating documents for a word nobody sees. `docs/content-architectuur.md` in hoet-eyewear still says `/journal/...` for the site routes; those follow when phase 2 is built.

## No author

Articles carry no byline of a person: the brand is the author. The `author` field and document type are removed, as is the *Auteurs* list under *Gedeeld* and the author condition in the live config test. On the site the article's author becomes the brand (in JSON-LD an `Organization`, the same `@id` as the publisher) instead of a `Person`.

## Image and video blocks up front

The body already had image, gallery, own video (mp4) and YouTube/Vimeo blocks, but they sat as plain entries in the editor's insert menu. Each block now has an icon, and the insert menu groups them: *Beeld en video* (image, gallery, video, embed) first, *Overige* (quote, divider, frame card, button) after. A test checks that every block except text sits in exactly one group, so a new block cannot be left out of the menu.

## Links to frames and collections are weak

The *Monturen* and *Collecties* links on an article were strong references: as long as a published article pointed at a frame, Sanity refused to unpublish or delete that frame. They are now weak, like the links in the text. The site already treats a link that no longer resolves, or a frame that is not active, as absent.

## Checks

`tsc --noEmit`, `sanity schema validate` (0 errors, 0 warnings), `sanity build`, offline vitest 62/62. The live `config.test.ts` was not run: there is no Sanity read token on the workbench. After merge: `npm run deploy` for the Studio.
params.title: Call the journal Blog, drop the author, put image and video blocks up front
